text:
Mike J: Heads up — opened PR #4782 for the TTL backfill on `user_sessions`. Can someone give this a quick look? It's a small migration but touches a hot table. https://git.company/repo/pull/4782 :eyes:

Sophia K: linking the PR — thanks Mike. quick q: does this run in batches or a single update? we should avoid long locks during peak hours.

Mike J: it runs in batches of 10k rows with a sleep between batches. added a `--dry-run` flag to the job. snippet:
```sql
-- soft-delete older sessions by setting ttl_ts
UPDATE user_sessions
SET ttl_ts = now() + interval '30 days'
WHERE last_active < now() - interval '90 days'
LIMIT 10000;
```

Liam R: can you add a check to skip rows already queued by the stream? we saw conflicts last time with the ingest job.

Mike J: good call — updated to join on `ingest_queue IS NULL` and added an index hint. also added a small canary config: `--max-rows=500` for the first run.

Carla T: CI is yelling about a schema diff in the migration file. do we need to run `db-schema-lint` locally?

Mike J: yea I missed that. fixed the migration header and re-pushed. CI should re-run.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: unit tests passed, integration tests queued. (build #2241) :white_check_mark:

Sophia K: quick ops question — what is the rollback plan if the backfill starts to slow down writes?

Mike J: we can pause the backfill via the job controller and the migration is idempotent. also set up an alarm on `write_latency > 150ms` to auto-pause. documented in the PR.

Eva Z: I can review after integration tests. if all green, happy to approve. can you add a short note in the PR description about risk level and expected runtime? :+1:

Mike J: done — added risk: low-medium, ETA ~2h at 10k batch config, will monitor. tagging @Eva Z for final signoff.

Liam R: :eyes: looks fine to me from the pipeline side. would prefer the index creation to be rolled out separately if it's large. Is index touched here?

Mike J: no new index in this PR — only using existing `last_active_idx`. planning separate PR for the new compound index and will coordinate off-peak.

Eva Z: reviewing now. small nit about the log message format. will leave an inline comment.

Mike J: thanks — addressing nit now. ping me if you want me to hold the merge until 4am UTC.

Sophia K: let's not merge during peak US hours. if tests pass, schedule for 03:30 UTC window. :calendar:

Eva Z: integration tests passed. pushed approval. :thumbsup:

Mike J: thanks all — merging into main and scheduling the job for 03:30 UTC per plan. I'll post updates if anything pops.
